It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 19, 2021}} The district encompasses the southern half of the province consisting of the municipalities of [[Bayog]], [[Dimataling]], [[Dinas, Zamboanga del Sur|Dinas]], [[Dumalinao]], [[Guipos]], [[Kumalarang]], [[Lakewood, Zamboanga del Sur|Lakewood]], [[Lapuyan]], [[Margosatubig]], [[Pitogo, Zamboanga del Sur|Pitogo]], [[San Miguel, Zamboanga del Sur|San Miguel]], [[San Pablo, Zamboanga del Sur|San Pablo]], [[Tabina, Zamboanga del Sur|Tabina]], [[Tigbao, Zamboanga del Sur|Tigbao]] and [[Vincenzo A. Sagun, Zamboanga del Sur|Vincenzo A. Sagun]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 19, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Victoria Yu|Jeyzel Victoria Yu]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 19, 2021}}{{cite news|url=https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/921556/members-of-lakas-cmd-in-romualdez-led-house-climb-to-109/story/|title=Members of Lakas-CMD in Romualdez-led House climb to 109|first=Llanesca|last=Panti|date=September 25, 2024|accessdate=September 27, 2024|work=[[GMA Integrated News]]}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
